description: Registry of this fork's custom features carried on top of an upstream base. One entry per feature. On every upstream catch-up, re-evaluate each entry: does upstream now provide this natively? Update `disposition` accordingly. Field meanings: tier = boundary tier (docs/HARNESS.md); commits = fork commits that introduced it; key_files = primary source it lives in; rides_seam = the upstream registry/hook it attaches to (or 'none' if novel/self-contained); upstream_equivalent = path to an upstream feature that supersedes it, or null; disposition = REPLAY (re-land as-is) | RE-DERIVE (seam moved/converged, re-express module body on new structure) | DROP (upstream fully supersedes) | DROP-ELIGIBLE (upstream has an adjacent feature; keep for now, candidate to retire); reapply_recipe = one-line how-to on replay.

reference_catchup.notes: Dependency reconcile in this catch-up: @chat-adapter/discord 4.26 -> 4.29 to track chat@4.29. Boundary gate (scripts/check-boundaries.sh + .boundaries-baseline + package.json check:boundaries alias) is fork-maintained and was NOT present in the v2 tree after replay — re-carry it.

features.title: Collab + responder module (multi-agent turn-taking on a shared channel)
features.rides_seam: registerMessageInterceptor (upstream converged to a native seam of this shape) + registerOutboundObserver (fork-only seam)
features.reapply_recipe: Router seam converged to upstream's native registerMessageInterceptor; re-point the module's interceptor registration at the native seam and keep the module body (turn-taking/responder logic) unchanged. State (collab_sessions, responder_state) moved to DB keyed by messaging_group_id; its migration (collab-state) rides after the messaging-group migration in the array.

features.title: Status-line module (surfaces current tool activity)
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land module as-is. Confirm the current_tool hook still exists upstream. The instance-side disable flag is an INSTANCE patch, reapplied separately from the stash.

features.title: Discord section-embeds (colored sections) + CJK-safe table -> PNG rendering
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land module + its fork-only outbound seams. Table->PNG path depends on @napi-rs/canvas (optional/native dep) and container CJK fonts (see replay-container-base). Verify section rendering live after cutover.

features.title: Agent-activity /agents interactive panel
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land module. First consumer of the component-handler seam; if upstream restructures interactive dispatch, re-point registration and keep panel render/snapshot logic.

features.title: /compact-everywhere slash command for engage-gated sub-channels
features.reapply_recipe: Upstream ships a typed /compact; ours is the slash form scoped to engage-gated sub-channels. Keep only while the sub-channel gating gap remains; retire once upstream /compact covers those channels.

features.title: Background spawn_subagent (ephemeral fire-and-forget worker)
features.reapply_recipe: Distinct ephemeral-worker pattern adjacent to upstream's agent-to-agent. Keep while the ephemeral (no messaging-group) worker shape is unmet upstream; re-evaluate each release.

features.title: /model + /effort commands
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land. Writes the upstream-native container_configs model/effort scalar columns via updateContainerConfigScalars — confirm those columns/API still exist upstream before trusting the write.

features.title: Slash + interaction framework
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land. Exports isAdmin, which is private in upstream; if upstream promotes/renames an equivalent, switch to it, otherwise keep the fork export. Underpins several other modules (compact-everywhere, agent-activity, model/effort) — replay before them.

features.title: NANO_UMASK + dart-tool wrapper (container-runner additive)
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land additive container-runner changes. Note container-runner.ts is also the site of INSTANCE-C (docker.sock) — keep the module (umask/wrapper) edit separate from the instance patch.

features.title: DART OpenDART MCP tool
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land the MCP tool. Credentials for the external API stay instance/OneCLI-managed, never committed.

features.title: Discord adapter install
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land. This is the @chat-adapter/discord dependency + wiring; keep the adapter version tracking the core `chat` package minor (see reference_catchup dependency reconcile).

features.title: Replay container base image (fonts / jira / apt / CJK support)
features.reapply_recipe: Re-land container base additions (CJK fonts back the discord table->PNG feature). Rebuild the container image after replay; prune the builder cache first (stale COPY layers).

features.title: INSTANCE patches (uncommitted, host-only)
features.reapply_recipe: Never committed; reapplied from a host stash after the merged build is in place (UPGRADING.md §5). Three checks: INSTANCE-A OneCLI bridge address (src/container-runtime.ts), INSTANCE-B status-line disabled flag, INSTANCE-C docker.sock passthrough (src/container-runner.ts). All are instance-tier per docs/HARNESS.md — verify present + correct for THIS host, keep out of git.
